<description>
Draft for now, as it requires upstream changes, and some codebase/style decisions.
Some of the fixes will be split off in advance.

Based on:
* #36744.
</description>

<commits>
2021d6f97f rpc: make AddInputs static, remove mismatched declaration

The header declared AddInputs(..., bool rbf), which was never defined,
while the definition takes std::optional<bool> and has no declaration.

1fabf596ce common: make FeeModeInfo static, remove mismatched declaration

35ec0bcdd7 rpc: remove undefined RPCResult::ToStringObj and ToDescriptionString

These were declared in fa6b061fc1 but never defined or used.

cd28d2847d qt: remove undefined BanTableModel::{start,stop}AutoRefresh

The definitions were removed in 43c1f5b8d7, but the declarations were
left behind.

5f13d8f4fd http: use MockableSteadyClock::time_point in ShouldDisconnect declaration

Match the definition, and the m_idle_since member.

a1dd0ffce7 [nomerge] leveldb changes

d31d6ec60b [nomerge] crc32c changes

b7968a2988 refactor: make translation-unit local functions static

These functions are only used within the file that defines them, and
have no declaration elsewhere, so -Wmissing-prototypes (clang) and
-Wmissing-declarations (GCC) warn about them. Give them internal
linkage.

fail_test_if_executed() is [[maybe_unused]], because TRACEPOINT discards
its arguments when tracing is disabled.

97e71d86ef fuzz: declare libFuzzer entry points before defining them

LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput and LLVMFuzzerInitialize are called by libFuzzer,
so they can't be static. Declare them first, to avoid
-Wmissing-prototypes / -Wmissing-declarations warnings.

252aab8bf9 rest: include httprpc.h for StartREST, InterruptREST and StopREST

bd6c41c4d1 build: add -Wmissing-prototypes

ef0ee930dd build: add -Wmissing-declarations

This is GCC's equivalent of clang's -Wmissing-prototypes for C++.

e9fac46b70 qt: declare ForceActivation in macdockiconhandler.h

It was declared locally in guiutil.cpp, so the definition was never
checked against the declaration.

d5d81abdae node: remove unused MakeMinisketch32FP

448308df8e refactor: make functions only used in their own translation unit static

These functions are declared in a header, but only used in the file that
defines them. Remove the declarations and give them internal linkage.

97a732735a refactor: make overloads only used in their own translation unit static

These overloads (and the walletdb Load* helpers) are declared in a header,
but only used in the file that defines them. Remove the declarations and
give them internal linkage.

30e857fe98 refactor: make forward-declared translation unit local functions static

89d95bea70 fuzz: make script_assets_test_minimizer ParseScriptFlags static

1668bacbae refactor: declare functions used by tests in their module headers

db799ef2fe rpc: declare getblockchaininfo and getdeploymentinfo in rpc/blockchain.h
</commits>
